content.short: World App is the flagship mobile wallet for the World ecosystem, providing secure identity and UBI access.
content.description:
World App is the definitive self-custodial digital asset manager built for the World (formerly Worldcoin) ecosystem, designed to provide a secure and intuitive gateway to the decentralized web. The app serves as the primary portal for managing a user's World ID—a privacy-preserving digital identity verified via the "Orb" biometric device. World App allows participants to claim their regular Universal Basic Income (UBI) grants in the form of WLD tokens and interact with a growing array of decentralized financial tools.

Operating natively on the World Chain—a high-performance Ethereum Layer 2 powered by the OP Stack—World App ensures near-instant transaction finality and ultra-low gas fees. The wallet also supports major assets like BTC, ETH, and USDC, providing a professional-grade environment for asset management. Through its commitment to proving humanness in the age of AI, World App is building the essential framework for a more equitable and transparent global digital economy where every individual can participate and benefit.
